# routeros_routing_isis_instance (Resource)




<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the IS-IS instance, referenced by the interface templates.

### Optional

- `___id___` (Number) <em>Resource ID type (.id / name). This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___path___` (String) <em>Resource path for CRUD operations. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___ts___` (String) <em>A set of transformations for field names. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `afi` (String) The address family this instance operates on.
- `areas` (Set of String) The area addresses of this IS-IS instance, that is the area part of the NET, for example `49.0001`. An instance may hold several area addresses during a reconfiguration.
- `areas_max` (Number) The maximum number of area addresses the instance accepts.
- `comment` (String)
- `disabled` (Boolean)
- `in_filter_chain` (String) Name of the routing filter chain that is applied to the routes received by this instance.
- `l1_lsp_max_age` (String) The lifetime advertised in the level 1 link state PDUs. A neighbour purges an LSP that has not been refreshed within this time.
- `l1_lsp_max_size` (Number) The maximum size in bytes of a level 1 link state PDU generated by this instance.
- `l1_lsp_refresh_interval` (String) The interval at which the own level 1 link state PDUs are regenerated so that they never reach their maximum age.
- `l1_lsp_update_interval` (String) The minimum interval between two consecutive regenerations of the own level 1 link state PDUs after a topology change.
- `l1_originate_default` (String) Controls the origination of the default route into the level 1 database.
- `l1_out_filter_chain` (String) Name of the routing filter chain applied to the routes advertised into the level 1 database.
- `l1_out_filter_select` (String) Name of the `/routing/filter/select-rule` chain that decides which of the candidate routes are advertised into the level 1 database.
- `l1_redistribute` (Set of String) Enable the redistribution of the listed route types into the level 1 database.
- `l2_lsp_max_age` (String) The lifetime advertised in the level 2 link state PDUs. A neighbour purges an LSP that has not been refreshed within this time.
- `l2_lsp_max_size` (Number) The maximum size in bytes of a level 2 link state PDU generated by this instance.
- `l2_lsp_refresh_interval` (String) The interval at which the own level 2 link state PDUs are regenerated so that they never reach their maximum age.
- `l2_lsp_update_interval` (String) The minimum interval between two consecutive regenerations of the own level 2 link state PDUs after a topology change.
- `l2_originate_default` (String) Controls the origination of the default route into the level 2 database.
- `l2_out_filter_chain` (String) Name of the routing filter chain applied to the routes advertised into the level 2 database.
- `l2_out_filter_select` (String) Name of the `/routing/filter/select-rule` chain that decides which of the candidate routes are advertised into the level 2 database.
- `l2_redistribute` (Set of String) Enable the redistribution of the listed route types into the level 2 database.
- `metric_type` (String) The style of the metrics generated and accepted by this instance.
  * old - the narrow metrics of the original IS-IS specification
  * wide - the wide metrics of RFC 5305
  * both - generate and accept both metric styles
- `system_id` (String) The six byte system identifier of this router, written as three groups of four hexadecimal digits, for example `90ab.cdef.0001`. It has to be unique in the whole IS-IS domain.
- `vrf` (String) The VRF table this resource operates on.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `inactive` (Boolean)
